scripts.dev: npm run build:corpus && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:ios: npm run build:corpus && concurrently -k -n worker,web,ios -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:worker" "SUTAMAYA_API_BASE=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev:web" "node scripts/native-live-reload.mjs ios"
scripts.dev:android: npm run build:corpus && concurrently -k -n worker,web,android -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:worker" "SUTAMAYA_API_BASE=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev:web" "node scripts/native-live-reload.mjs android"
scripts.dev:native: npm run build:corpus && concurrently -k -n worker,web,ios,android -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:worker" "SUTAMAYA_API_BASE=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev:web" "node scripts/native-live-reload.mjs ios" "node scripts/native-live-reload.mjs android"
scripts.build: npm run build:corpus && npm run build --workspace web
